_comment: One truth table, two consumers. pytest (tests/test_ui_engine_drift.py) drives engine.approve with a NON-HUMAN principal through every row; vitest (ui/src/debate2.test.tsx) renders the ApprovalCard's verdict sentence for the same rows. If the engine's rule and the UI's wording ever disagree, one of the two runners goes red. Keys: workflow_allow_agent_approval = Budget.allow_agent_approval on the workflow; policy_agent_approval_allowed = OperatorPolicy.agent_approval_allowed (null = no policy configured); accept = whether engine.approve records the grant for a non-human principal on a human-only gate.
